frontmatter.title: Get Notified When an Inmate Is Released with WebMonitor.fyi
frontmatter.description: Learn how to use WebMonitor.fyi to receive notifications when an inmate is released. Stay informed by monitoring official websites for updates on inmate custody status.
frontmatter.author: Sarah Lee

post.content:
## Introduction

Staying informed about the custody status of an inmate can be crucial for various reasons, including personal safety, peace of mind, and legal considerations. Whether you're a concerned family member, a victim, or part of an organization that needs to stay updated, knowing when an inmate is released is important. WebMonitor.fyi enables you to monitor official websites for updates and receive instant notifications when changes occur. In this guide, we'll show you how to set up monitoring to get notified when an inmate is released.


## Why Monitor Inmate Release Information?

Monitoring inmate release information can provide several benefits:



- Safety and Preparedness: Victims and witnesses can take necessary precautions upon an inmate's release.

- Family Reconnection: Families can prepare to support the reintegration of their loved ones back into society.

- Legal Obligations: Organizations and authorities may need to stay informed for compliance and supervision purposes.




## How WebMonitor.fyi Can Help

WebMonitor.fyi leverages AI technology to monitor web pages intelligently. Here's how it assists you:



- Customized Monitoring: Monitor specific pages of official correctional facility websites or inmate locator services.

- Natural Language Criteria: Use simple language to define what changes you want to be notified about.

- Instant Notifications: Receive real-time alerts via email when the inmate's status changes.




## Important Considerations

Please note that while WebMonitor.fyi can assist in monitoring publicly available information, it's essential to respect privacy laws and ethical guidelines. Always ensure that the information you are monitoring is legally accessible and that you use it responsibly.


## Step-by-Step Guide to Monitoring Inmate Release Information


### Step 1: Identify the Official Website

Locate the official website that provides custody status and release information for the inmate you're interested in. This could be a state Department of Corrections website, a county jail inmate search page, or a federal inmate locator service.


### Step 2: Find the Inmate's Information Page

Use the inmate's identification number or name to navigate to their specific information page. Ensure that this page updates with changes to their custody status.


### Step 3: Log In to WebMonitor.fyi

Access your WebMonitor.fyi account. If you don't have one yet, you can sign up for free.


### Step 4: Create a New Monitor

In your dashboard, click on "Add New Monitor". Paste the URL of the inmate's information page into the URL field.


### Step 5: Set Your Monitoring Criteria

In the criteria section, specify what you want to monitor using natural language. Examples:



- "Notify me when the custody status changes."

- "Alert me if the inmate is released."

- "Inform me when the release date is updated."



Our AI will interpret these instructions and set up monitoring accordingly.


### Step 6: Choose Monitoring Frequency

Select how often you want WebMonitor.fyi to check the page. Depending on the expected release date, you may choose to monitor daily or weekly.


### Step 7: Configure Notifications

Choose your preferred method for receiving alerts. Email notifications are enabled by default. Upgrade your plan if you require SMS or API notifications.


### Step 8: Save and Activate Your Monitor

Review your settings and click "Save" to activate the monitor. WebMonitor.fyi will now monitor the page based on your criteria and notify you of any changes.


## Additional Safety Tips

While monitoring can help you stay informed, consider these additional safety measures:



- Create a Safety Plan: If you're concerned about your safety, develop a detailed plan and share it with trusted individuals.

- Use Official Notification Services: Register with official victim notification systems like VINE for additional updates.

- Stay Vigilant: Keep aware of your surroundings and maintain open communication with law enforcement if necessary.




## Conclusion

WebMonitor.fyi provides a practical solution for staying updated on inmate release information by monitoring official websites. By setting up customized monitors, you can receive timely notifications and take appropriate actions based on the updates. Start using WebMonitor.fyi today to stay informed and enhance your peace of mind.
